subject: QBR prep: concise sitrep on roadmap health, launch timing, and top delivery risks
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, Sasha Rivera <sasha@acme.ai>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.ai>
Date: 2027-03-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: QBR prep: concise sitrep on roadmap health, launch timing, and top delivery risks

Team —

Quick ask as we lock the QBR packet: I need a tight, slide-ready snapshot of where we stand on the product & engineering roadmap items that feed the April launch window. Specifically:

1) Current health for the three launch pillars (Serving runtime, Smart routing, Console rollout) — green/amber/red + 1-line rationale.
2) Any timeline shifts since last week and the expected new ship dates.
3) Top 3 delivery risks per pillar and the concrete mitigations owner-assigned.
4) Which items, if delayed, would force a change to the public launch date vs. being absorbed into post-launch patches.

Please reply with bullets by EOD Tuesday so I can fold into the leadership pack. If you attach the risk matrix, include the single line I can paste into the QBR slide.

Thanks — short and specific is best. Meeting to sync is Wed 10:00 PT if we need to adjudicate.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Director, GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, Sasha Rivera <sasha@acme.ai>
Date: 2027-03-27T13:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: concise sitrep on roadmap health, launch timing, and top delivery risks

Monica — thanks for the ask. Quick status from infra/serving point of view: 

- Serving runtime: Amber — performance regressions on long-context streaming surfaced in nightly tests (approx 12% latency tail increase at 4k tokens). Root cause: new KV cache eviction change interacts poorly with recent kernel scheduling tweak. Mitigation: rollback kernel change + targeted hotfix; owner: Karthik; ETA for hotfix to staging: 48 hours. If unresolved, we degrade through stricter batching controls which increases cost but preserves latency SLOs.

- Smart routing: Green — routing policies validated in canary (region-us-east). Minor throttling tweak planned for burst scenarios; no launch impact. Owner: Irene.

- Console rollout (admin UX + rollout controls): Amber — two blockers: role-based access control bug (RBAC) causing intermittent permission errors, and telemetry spike in dashboard queries under load. Mitigations: RCA for RBAC in progress (owner: Tessa) with patch scheduled in 72 hours; telemetry being mitigated by query caching and rate-limit isolation (owner: Infra team). If RBAC patch misses the window, we can gate advanced controls behind a feature flag and proceed with a reduced admin surface for launch.

Timeline shifts: currently tracking a 1-week slip for the admin-console GA if RBAC patch slips; serving hotfix is on a 48h critical path but contained.

Top risks summary line for slide: "Primary risk: serving runtime latency regressions under long-context workloads; secondary: RBAC edge failures in admin console — mitigations in flight, hotfixes targeted within 72h."

Irene/Karthik/Tessa — please add any details I missed.

—Vivek
VP, Engineering
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, Sasha Rivera <sasha@acme.ai>
Date: 2027-03-29T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: concise sitrep on roadmap health, launch timing, and top delivery risks

Adding product detail and attaching the risk matrix. See attachment: launch_risk_matrix.xlsx

- Serving runtime (owner: Karthik): Product note — customers on trial with long-context usage (Orbis Health, Acme PoC) show increased error-rate when token lengths exceed 6k due to fallback heuristics. Priority mitigation: prioritize the KV eviction rollback and add a long-context smoke test to CI. Action: Karthik to produce a staging verification checklist by 2027-03-29 17:00 PT.

- Smart routing (owner: Irene): No launch-timing impact. Action: finalize burst-policy knob defaults by Friday and include in QBR performance appendix.

- Console rollout (owner: Tessa): RBAC bug affects some existing enterprise roles (audit-only). If not fixed before GA, propose "enterprise GA with RBAC limited" messaging and an explicit patch plan communicated to customers. Action: Tessa to draft customer-facing note and rollback plan (due 2027-03-30 EOD).

Attachments: QBR_snapshot_2027Q1.pdf (one-slide summary for leadership), launch_risk_matrix.xlsx (detailed risk register), canary_rollout_plan.md (canary criteria + rollback steps)

I prepared a one-line summary for the QBR slide that Monica can paste: 
"Launch readiness: core serving mitigations in flight; non-blocking console RBAC to be scoped behind feature gating for GA if necessary — aim to hold public launch date while accepting a reduced admin surface for initial release."

Irene
Sr. Product Lead
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, Sasha Rivera <sasha@acme.ai>
Date: 2027-04-01T16:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: concise sitrep on roadmap health, launch timing, and top delivery risks

Confirming engineering timeline and next steps — follow-up from today's sync: 

- Hotfix status (Serving runtime): Kernel rollback committed to branch hotfix/kv-rollback. Staging verification checklist attached to the ticket. Deploy to staging scheduled 04-02 02:00 PT; production canary 04-03 06:00 PT with roll-forward/rollback gates. If staging shows no regressions, we keep original public launch date (2027-04-10).

- Canary plan: see canary_rollout_plan.md — criteria: 99th pct latency within 15% of baseline for 24h and error-rate <= 0.1% for long-context flows. Owner: Karthik + Platform SRE.

- Console RBAC: Triage shows two database migration order issues; patch slated for 04-03 EOD. If that misses, we will ship with RBAC disabled for advanced roles and communicate the restriction (Irene/Tessa will own comms).

I'll update the ticket with the prod canary link and the runbook. If we hit the canary criteria, push ahead. If not, we revert and declare a 1-week delay and notify customers.

Meeting link for final pre-brief: https://meetings.redwood.ai/room/622-qbr-prep (Wed 10:00 PT)

—Karthik
Engineering Lead
